summary: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah will perform the groundbreaking ceremony for the NHEC Multi-State Cooperative Society in Pune, Maharashtra.
The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment showcased artisans' products at the 45th India International Trade Fair 2026.
Belgium Navy Commander Rear Admiral Tanguy Botman visited India.
The global cinematic festival in Goa is set to open with Pawel Pawlikowski's film 'Fatherland'.
DRI seized 20 kg of methamphetamine tablets concealed in a specially built cavity of a tipper truck in Assam and arrested one person.

A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) is to be signed between the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment and the Directorate General of Defence Estates to expand senior citizen welfare schemes in cantonment boards across the country.
CCI approved the acquisition of a stake in Yatharth Hospital and Trauma Care Services Limited by Rasmalai Limited.
IICA organized a stakeholder consultation meeting in New Delhi where experts emphasized the shift from 'control to trust' in public policy.
Dr. Jitendra Singh celebrated World Diabetes Day in Italy with enthusiastic participation from the Indian diaspora, highlighting India's scientific and healthcare advancements.
NSS organized block-level sports competitions across the country to unite youth against substance abuse.
The 57th International Film Festival of India will feature 25 feature films and 20 non-feature films under the Indian Panorama.
The President of India greeted citizens on the occasion of Chhath Puja.
BRICS cinema along with 21 films from around the world will be showcased at the 57th International Film Festival of India.
The Prime Minister will participate in the 'Janjatiya Gaurav Divas' program on November 15.
Indian Railways approved a weekly train service connecting Janakpur Dham in Nepal to Ayodhya in India.
Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chauhan announced an immediate sanction of 5 million (5 lakh) PMAY houses for the poor in Odisha.
'I Matter', a story of identity, belonging, and a second chance, will be screened as the mid-fest film at IFFI 2026.
The first regional conference on 'Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0' concluded in Tiruchirappalli, emphasizing sustainable drinking water services and community ownership.
The Lok Sabha Speaker paid tributes to Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru.

questions.question: Which railway service was recently approved by Indian Railways to connect Janakpur Dham in Nepal to Ayodhya in India?
questions.explanation: Indian Railways approved a weekly train service connecting Janakpur Dham in Nepal to Ayodhya in India.

questions.question: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chauhan announced an immediate gift of how many PM Awas houses for the poor in Odisha?
questions.explanation: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chauhan announced an immediate sanction of 5 lakh (5 million) PM Awas houses for every poor person in Odisha.

questions.question: Where is Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah scheduled to perform the groundbreaking ceremony for the NHEC Multi-State Cooperative Society?
questions.explanation: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah will perform the groundbreaking ceremony for the NHEC Multi-State Cooperative Society in Pune, Maharashtra.

questions.question: Which film is chosen to open the global cinematic festival in Goa?
questions.explanation: The global cinematic festival in Goa starts with Pawel Pawlikowski's film 'Fatherland'.

questions.question: How many feature films and non-feature films will be showcased under the Indian Panorama at the 57th International Film Festival of India?
questions.explanation: Under the Indian Panorama at the 57th International Film Festival of India, 25 feature films and 20 non-feature films will be showcased.

questions.question: Where was the first regional conference on 'Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0' concluded recently?
questions.explanation: The first regional conference on 'Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0' concluded in Tiruchirappalli, emphasizing sustainable drinking water services.

questions.question: Which country's Navy Commander, Rear Admiral Tanguy Botman, recently visited India?
questions.explanation: Belgium Navy Commander Rear Admiral Tanguy Botman visited India.

questions.question: In which state did the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seize 20 kg of methamphetamine tablets hidden in a tipper truck?
questions.explanation: In Assam, DRI seized 20 kg of methamphetamine tablets concealed in a tipper truck and arrested one person.
